title: Notification regarding Hon'ble Mr. Justice A.Guneshwar Sharma will hold a Single Bench on 25th June, 2025 only for delivery of judgment.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 24th June, 2025
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma will hold Single Bench tomorrow
25tf1 June, 2025 only for delivery of judgment.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. AJIT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
